svg.title: ViTMatte Small
svg.desc: Guided alpha matting,input normalized RGB3 channels + trimap1 channel at512 × 512,native eval.
svg.text: Guided alpha matting,input normalized RGB3 channels + trimap1 channel at512 × 512,native eval.

g.text: Window blocks pad32 to42,partition nine14×14 windows,
then crop back. There is no cyclic window shift orCLS token.
Retain raw input plus all three detail levels as decoder skips.

g.aria-label: Attention on local windows orfull grid
g.data-label: Attention on local windows orfull grid
g.text: Attention on local windows orfull grid
Global layers subsequently run the residual CNN bottleneck.
Each relative table is27×64 for14×14 window attention;
63×64 for32×32 global attention. Tables resize if needed.

g.aria-label: CNN residual after each global layer
g.data-label: CNN residual after each global layer
g.text: CNN residual after each global layer
No additional finalbackbone normalization after layer11.
Known trimap pixels are constrained after the single decoder sigmoid; unknown0.5 pixels keep predictedalpha.
Source: libreyolo/models/vitmatte/nn.py and model.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
